parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
* **true** (default): Automatically uses coupons.
* **false**: Does not automatically use coupons.

> After a coupon is used, the amount deducted by the coupon is not refunded if you downgrade the instance.

parameters.name: BurstingEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the [I/O performance burst feature for premium performance disks](~~2340501~~). Valid values:

- **true**: Enabled.
- **false**: Disabled.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The instance edition. Valid values:

- **Basic**: Basic Edition
- **HighAvailability**: High-availability Edition
- **cluster**: Cluster Edition

parameters.name: ColdDataEnabled
parameters.description:
<props="china">Specifies whether to enable the [cold data archiving feature](~~2701832~~) for general-purpose cloud disks. Valid values:</props>

- <props="china">**true**: Enabled.</props>

- <props="china">**false**: Disabled.</props>

<props="intl">Reserved parameter.</props>

parameters.name: DBInstanceClass
parameters.description: The instance type. For more information, see [Instance types](~~26312~~).

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call [DescribeDBInstances](~~2628785~~) to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: DBInstanceStorage
parameters.description:
The [target storage capacity](~~26312~~), in GB. You can call the [DescribeAvailableClasses](~~610393~~) operation to query the available storage capacity range for the target instance type.

> * You must specify at least one of this parameter and the **DBInstanceClass** parameter.
> * You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceAttribute](~~610394~~) operation to query the current storage capacity of the instance.

parameters.name: DBInstanceStorageType
parameters.description:
The instance storage type. Valid values:

* **general_essd**: premium performance disk (recommended)
* **cloud_essd**: PL1 ESSD
* **cloud_essd2**: PL2 ESSD
* **cloud_essd3**: PL3 ESSD

sub_parameters.name: NodeId
sub_parameters.description:
The unique identifier of the node, used to specify a node.
> This parameter is valid only for Cluster Edition instances.

sub_parameters.name: Role
sub_parameters.description:
The node type. Valid values:
* **Master**: primary node.
* **Slave**: secondary node.

> For Cluster Edition instances, you can leave this parameter empty and specify the NodeId parameter to identify the node.

sub_parameters.name: VSwitchId
sub_parameters.description: The vSwitch ID of the instance.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The type of specification change for the instance. Valid values:

- **Up** (default): Upgrades a subscription instance, or upgrades/downgrades a pay-as-you-go instance.
- **Down**: Downgrades a subscription instance.

parameters.name: EffectiveTime
parameters.description:
The effective period for the new configurations. Valid values:
> **Changing some configurations may affect the instance**. Read the impact section in the [feature documentation](~~96061~~) before you configure this parameter. Perform the operation during off-peak hours.
* **Immediate** (default): The new configurations take effect immediately.
* **MaintainTime**: The new configurations take effect during the [maintenance window](~~610402~~).
* **ScheduleTime**: The new configurations take effect at a specified time. The time must be at least 12 hours later than the current time. The actual switchover time follows the formula: EffectiveTime = ScheduleTime + SwitchTime. Allocate sufficient time for the switchover.

parameters.name: IoAccelerationEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the [Buffer Pool Extension (BPE) feature](~~2527067~~) for premium performance disks. Valid values:

- **1**: enabled
- **0**: not enabled

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description:
The parameters and their values. All parameter values are of the STRING type. You can call the DescribeParameterTemplates operation to query parameter names and values.

> If you specify the **ParameterGroupId** parameter and both ParameterGroupId and Parameters modify the same parameter, the value specified in Parameters takes precedence.

parameters.name: SwitchTime
parameters.description: The time at which the parameter modification is executed. The EffectiveTime parameter must be set to ScheduleTime. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). > The time must be later than the current time (the time when the call is made).

parameters.name: TargetMinorVersion
parameters.description:
The [minor engine version](~~126002~~) of the PostgreSQL instance. If the specification change fails because the current minor engine version is not supported, specify the minor engine version to **upgrade the minor engine version during the specification change**.

Format: `rds_postgres_<MajorVersion>00_<MinorVersion>`. Example for version 12 with minor version 20200830: `rds_postgres_1200_20200830`.
